extraction.text:
Renu Sharma

Email: renu280489@gmail.com

Phone: +91- 9999046408

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/dr-renu-s-34265017a

Professional Summary

Innovative Data Scientist with proven success in evaluating requirements and designing AI/ML-driven solutions, including Generative AI applications. Skilled in building end-to-end machine learning models, optimizing performance, and delivering business impact. Out-of-the-box thinker and problem solver with hands-on experience in data analysis, predictive modeling, and AI-powered automation. Strong track record of leading teams, fostering collaboration, and ensuring timely delivery of projects. Adapts well to varied project scopes and consistently drives innovation in software and AI development.

Key Skills

Machine Learning, NLP, Numpy, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, Data Visualization Prompt Engineering Gen AI: LLM, Transformer Architecture, GPT Models, DALL-E, RAG, multi-modal models, Agentic AI: Autogen (Microsoft), LangChain Agents, JIRA, Product fault-finding Transformers (e.g., BERT, GPT, T5, LLaMA) Python Programming: Django, Flask, FastAPI, Rest API, Microservices, OOP, Unit Testing, Code Optimization. AI: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Computer Vision, Reinforcement Learning, Neural Networks, Deep Learning. Tableau Docker Statistical Modeling API design SQL & Database Management Image Processing GCP, Azure Data Scientist Python, MATLAB Kubernetes, Docker, MLOPs, CI/CD pipeline



Professional Experience

1. Software Engineer

Orange Business Services, Gurugram (Hybrid) — December/2022 to Present

Wrote and developed new and well-tested code for different software projects.

Worked closely with other team members to identify and remove software bugs.

Developed new, efficient and well-tested code for variety of different software projects.

Worked with developers to construct algorithms and flowcharts.

Analyzed data to determine installation of new systems required.

Managed system testing and validation procedures to gauge reliability.

Projects:

ATG (Test Automation using NLP & GenAI): Designed an NLP-based model to fetch manual test cases from JIRA and automate them using Python libraries. Managed data with MongoDB, built CI/CD pipelines, and used Docker for containerization. Deployed solutions on Azure & GCP.

Smart Agriculture (AI + Edge Computing): Developed an object detection model to classify insect types using supervised learning. Integrated edge computing for real-time inference. Implemented MLOps pipelines with Kubernetes for scalable deployment.

Low-Resource Language Translator (NLP + Research): Built an end-to-end NLP-based translation system, including parallel corpus creation and model training. Led patent filing and research paper publication, showcasing innovation in low-resource language processing.

SANTOS (Enterprise Document Management): Supported electronic contract management (prepaid & postpaid connections). Enhanced automation and scalability using Azure & GCP services.

Insurance AI Project: Led development of AI-driven workflows for insurance document processing. Used Docker for containerization and cloud deployment (Azure & GCP), ensuring reliability and performance.

OBOT (Conversational AI with RAG): Designed and deployed a chatbot using intent mapping and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for contextual query handling. Managed dataset creation, preprocessing, and model training. Led a team to deliver the project end-to-end, ensuring improved automation and faster query resolution.

2. Assistant Professor

AKGEC, Ghaziabad — July/2016 to November/2022

Implemented strategic lesson planning, monitoring progress and performance against set targets.

Delivered engaging lectures, seminars and tutorials, increasing class productivity.



Coordinated with colleagues in continuous reviews and curriculum development, ensuring students received high-quality courses.

Assisted in planning and development of teaching materials, workbooks and class projects.

Significantly reduced teacher’s workload by helping to plan and deliver classroom  activities.

Certifications

1. Advanced Certification in Data Scientist IIIT Bengaluru

January 2022-October 2022

Constructed deep learning models and scalable machine learning systems.

Applied analysis skills, leveraging insights, developing and deploying data models and evaluating and improving existing models to create solutions.

Executed simulations on business data to identify financial impacts of decisions and frameworks for different sources.

Pre-processed structures and unstructured data by collaborating with diverse teams in implementing model and monitoring outcomes.

Facilitated and executed strategies to educated customers on data analysis and interpretation.

2. Data Scientist and Machine Learning Intern Gilbert Research Centre, Bengaluru

July 2022- July 2022

Presented information using data visualization techniques, proposing solutions and strategies- to drive business change and solve problems.

Filtered and assessed data from different views, searching for patterns indicating problems or opportunities and communicated results to help drive business growth.

Pre-processed structured and unstructured data by collaborating with diverse teams in implementing models and monitoring outcomes.

Mentored and encouraged analytics teams to master data mining, management and analysis techniques.

3. Certified CueMath Teacher

April 2021-September 2021



Set and communicated ground rules for classroom to encourage respect and personal responsibility.

Established positive relationships with students, parents, fellow teachers and school administrators.

Accepted coaching from fellow teachers and administrators to improve teaching quality.

Earned positive feedback from parents regarding classroom instruction and students learning success.

Designed presentations, visual aids and worksheets to enhance learning experience.

Education

PhD Machine Learning JIIT Noida October 2024           87% M. Tech. Image Processing AKGEC Ghaziabad 2015      89% B. Tech. Electronics and Communication Engineering ABES Institute of Technology 2011     80.02% 12th Science Stream DAVPS Ghaziabad 2007     78.88% 10th Science Stream DAVPS Ghaziabad 2005     72.32%

Languages 

English

Hindi

Accomplishments

Qualified GATE exam in 2013 with 95.5%.

Won Rs 10,000/- for securing good average in Academics

Recorded Video Lectures for SwayamPrabha Channel and Dr APJAKTU, Lucknow for two subjects namely “Data Communication Network” and “Wireless and Mobile Communication”.

Won Marker Cup in Class-12th.

Achieved second position in “Anuvrat Essay Competition” at state level.
